result.summary: 这篇论文提出并论证了“柏拉图表示假说”：不同神经网络（跨架构、目标、甚至模态）对数据的表示正在收敛，并趋向于一个反映现实世界联合分布的共享统计模型 [abstract][S1.p2][S1.p4]。作者综述了文献中表示收敛的证据，并通过实验测量了78个视觉模型之间、以及视觉与语言模型之间的表示对齐，发现对齐随模型能力和规模提升而增强 [S2.SS2.p2][S2.SS3.p5]。论文进一步提出任务通用性、模型容量和简单性偏置三种机制来解释收敛 [S3.SS1.p2][S3.SS2.p2][S3.SS3.p2]，并给出一个理想化世界中对比学习收敛到PMI核的形式化分析 [S4.SS2.p4][S4.SS2.p6]。作者还讨论了收敛在跨模态数据共享、翻译适应、减少幻觉与偏见等方面的潜在意义 [S5.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1][S5.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1][S5.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p1]，并明确列出了若干反例与局限 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1][S6.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1][S6.SS0.SSS0.Px6.p1]。

research_question.text: 论文要探讨的核心问题是：不同神经网络模型对数据的表示是否正在收敛，这种收敛是否会持续，以及最终会收敛到什么表示 [S1.p2][S1.p3]。作者提出的中心假说是，这种收敛存在一个终点和驱动原则：不同模型都在试图获得对现实的表示，即对生成观测数据的世界事件联合分布的表示 [S1.p4]。作者将这一收敛的假想表示称为“柏拉图表示”，并指出其与科学哲学中的“收敛实在论”以及表示学习文献中的相关论点有关 [S1.p5]。

evidence.quote: This paper explores one aspect of this trend: representational convergence.
We argue that there is a growing similarity in how datapoints are represented in different neural network models.
What has led to this convergence? Will it continue? And ultimately, where does it end?
different models are all trying to arrive at a representation of reality, meaning a representation of the joint distribution over events in the world that generate the data we observe.
We call this converged hypothetical representation the “platonic representation” in reference to Plato’s Allegory of the Cave
our hypothesis is also related to the notion of “convergent realism” in the philosophy of science

method.text: 论文将表示定义为向量嵌入，并用其诱导的核（相似性结构）来刻画，将表示对齐定义为两个核之间相似性的度量 [S2.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1]。实验中作者采用互最近邻度量，即两个核诱导的k近邻集合的平均交集除以k [S2.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p2]。为测量跨模态对齐，作者使用配对数据集（如Wikipedia图像-标题数据集WIT）作为桥梁，分别计算图像核与文本核之间的对齐 [S2.SS3.p5]。此外，论文提出任务通用性、模型容量和简单性偏置三种假说来解释收敛 [S3.SS1.p2][S3.SS2.p2][S3.SS3.p2]，并在理想化世界模型下形式化分析对比学习收敛到PMI核 [S4.SS2.p4][S4.SS2.p6]。

evidence.quote: We restrict our attention to representations that are vector embeddings.
we define representational alignment as a measure of the similarity of the similarity structures induced by two representations
we use a mutual nearest-neighbor metric that measures the mean intersection of the $k$ -nearest neighbor sets induced by two kernels
To measure cross-modal alignment, we use paired datasets to bridge the two modalities.
we use the Wikipedia captions dataset $\{(x_{i},y_{i})\}_{i}$, composed of images from Wikipedia ( $x_{i}$) and their corresponding captions ( $y_{i}$).
The Multitask Scaling Hypothesis There are fewer representations that are competent for $N$ tasks than there are for $M<N$ tasks.
The Capacity Hypothesis Bigger models are more likely to converge to a shared representation than smaller models.
The Simplicity Bias Hypothesis Deep networks are biased toward finding simple fits to the data, and the bigger the model, the stronger the bias.
the contrastive learners we consider are minimized by a representation $f_{X}$ whose kernel is $K_{\mathsf{PMI}}$ (up to a constant offset).
for any modality in our idealized world, we observe representational convergence to the same kernel, which represents certain pairwise statistics of $\mathbb{P}(\mathbf{Z})$.

experiments.text: 在视觉-视觉对齐方面，作者评估了78个视觉模型，包括17个不同规模的ViT、1个随机初始化ResNet-50、11个在ImageNet-1k、Places-365及9个合成数据集上对比学习的ResNet-50，以及49个在ImageNet-100、Places-365及47个数据集上训练的ResNet-18 [A3.SS1.p1]。表示质量用VTAB全部19个分类任务的线性探测评估，训练和验证集最多子采样10000个样本，任务被视为解决的标准是性能达到78个模型中最佳性能的80%以上 [A3.SS1.p2]。对齐度量使用Places-365验证集上1000个图像表示的k=10最近邻 [A3.SS1.p3]。在跨模态对齐方面，作者比较了BLOOM、OpenLLaMA、LLaMA等语言模型家族与ImageNet-21K分类、MAE、DINOv2、CLIP等视觉模型，使用WIT数据集1024个样本、k=10最近邻，并对特征做L2归一化及截断95百分位以上的元素 [A3.SS2.p1][A3.SS2.p2][A3.SS2.p3]。

evidence.quote: We consider 78 vision models in total
$17$ ViT models ranging from ViT-tiny to ViT-giant, trained on tasks including ImageNet-21k classification, Masked Autoencoders, DINO, and CLIP
$11$ ResNet-50 models trained with contrastive learning on ImageNet-1k, Places-365, and $9$ synthetic image datasets
$49$ ResNet-18 models trained with Alignment and Uniformity contrastive loss on ImageNet-100, Places-365, and $47$ realistic and synthetic image datasets
we evaluate linear probing performance on all 19 VTAB classification tasks
We consider a representation solves a task if its performance is $\geq 80\%$ of the best performance on that task across all 78 models.
we use $k=10$ nearest neighbors over $1000$ image representations computed on Places-365’s validation dataset.
The language model families we consider are BLOOM, OpenLLaMA, and LLaMA.
We mainly consider the popular vision models: classification on ImageNet-21K, MAE, DINOv2, CLIP, and CLIP finetuned on ImageNet-12K.
we use $k=10$ nearest neighbors over 1024 samples from WIT (Wikipedia-based Image Text;).
We apply $l_{2}$ normalization to the features before measuring the distance.
we truncate the elements in the features that are above the $95$ -th percentile.

findings.text: 视觉模型的对齐随能力提升而增强：在VTAB上解决更多任务的模型彼此更对齐，高迁移性能的模型形成紧密聚集的表示，而弱性能模型的表示更分散 [S2.SS2.p2]。跨模态方面，语言模型的语言建模能力越强，越倾向于与视觉模型对齐，反之亦然；CLIP模型因显式语言监督表现出更高对齐，但在ImageNet分类微调后对齐下降 [S2.SS3.p5]。对齐还能预测下游性能：与DINOv2对齐更好的LLM在Hellaswag和GSM8K上表现更好 [S2.SS5.p1]。在理想化分析中，对比学习者的核收敛到PMI核，且由于双射观测保持概率，不同模态收敛到同一核 [S4.SS2.p4][S4.SS2.p6]。颜色案例研究显示，从图像共现和语言共现学到的颜色表示大致恢复相同的感知表示 [S4.SS2.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

evidence.quote: models with high transfer performance form a tightly clustered set of representations, while models with weak performance have more variable representations.
the better an LLM is at language modeling, the more it tends to aligns with vision models
The converse effect also holds: the better a vision models is, the more it tends to align with LLMs.

We find that CLIP models, which are trained with explicit language supervision, exhibit a higher level of alignment. However, this alignment decreases after being fine-tuned on ImageNet classification
Figure 4 supports this hypothesis by demonstrating improved performance on commonsense reasoning (Hellaswag;) and mathematical problem solving (GSM8K;) as alignment improves.
the contrastive learners we consider are minimized by a representation $f_{X}$ whose kernel is $K_{\mathsf{PMI}}$ (up to a constant offset).
for any modality in our idealized world, we observe representational convergence to the same kernel, which represents certain pairwise statistics of $\mathbb{P}(\mathbf{Z})$.
learning cooccurrence statistics in either domain recovers roughly the same perceptual representation.

limitations.text: 作者承认，不同模态可能包含不同信息，两个模型若访问根本不同的信息就无法收敛到相同表示；其数学论证仅严格适用于Z的双射投影，对损失性或随机观测函数不成立 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p1][S6.SS0.SSS0.Px1.p2]。并非所有表示目前都在收敛，例如机器人领域尚无标准化的世界状态表示方式，硬件昂贵缓慢造成训练数据数量与多样性的瓶颈 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px2.p1]。AI社区的研究者偏见和集体偏好、以及“硬件彩票”可能推动模型向类人表示收敛 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px3.p1]。专用智能可能不会收敛，论文的论证只适用于被优化以在许多任务上表现良好的智能 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px4.p1]。对齐度量本身存在争议，作者只重点使用互最近邻一种度量 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px5.p1]。此外，实验中对齐分数仅达到0.16（理论最大值为1），这是强对齐加噪声还是存在重大差异尚属开放问题 [S6.SS0.SSS0.Px6.p1]。

evidence.quote: Two different models cannot converge to the same representation if they have access to fundamentally different information.
our mathematical argument in Section 4 only strictly holds for bijective projections of $\mathbf{Z}$
This will not hold true for either lossy or stochastic observation functions.
in robotics there is not yet a standardized approach to representing world states in the same way as there is for representing images and text.
One limitation lies in the hardware used in robotics, which is often expensive and slow. This creates a bottleneck in the quantity and diversity of training data.
Researcher bias and collective preferences within the AI community have shaped the trajectory of model development.
the “hardware lottery” suggests that the success of AI models can also depend on the compatibility of their design with available computational architectures
Our argument only holds for intelligences that are optimized to perform well on many tasks.
We focused on one particular alignment measure, mutual nearest-neighbor, in our experiments
there is active debate on the merits and deficiencies of all these ways of measuring alignment.
alignment clearly increases but only reaches a score of $0.16$, according to our mutual nearest-neighbor metric. The maximum theoretical value for this metric is $1$.
We leave this as an open question.
